hints.text: For two negative numbers, the one closer to $0$ is farther right on the number line, and farther right means greater.
$-7$ is $7$ units left of $0$ and $-3$ is $3$ units left of $0$. Decide which one sits closer to zero.
$-3$ is closer to $0$ and to the right of $-7$, so $-3$ is greater.

explanation: Both numbers are negative, so both are to the left of $0$ on the number line.
$-3$ is $3$ units from $0$ and $-7$ is $7$ units from $0$, so $-3$ is closer to $0$.
Being closer to $0$ on the negative side means being farther right, so $-3 > -7$ and the greater number is $-3$.
